title: Delivery glossary and definition of done (external reporting)

definitions.meaning: Verified end-to-end in staging against customer systems and signed off by QA. Safe to state in external reporting.
Confirmed and accepted by the customer where acceptance applies.
All due milestones are Confirmed under this glossary and no High risks are open.

context_note: Applies to all reporting shared with external stakeholders. Engineering and PMO maintain separate working terms for internal use.
content:
Purpose. This glossary defines status terms for reporting to external stakeholders. Internal team terms may differ; before an internal report is used externally, its statuses must be checked against these definitions.

Confirmed: the deliverable is verified end-to-end in staging against customer systems and signed off by QA. Code merge and unit tests are not sufficient.

Green (external): every due milestone is Confirmed in the sense above and no High risks are open. If an integration has not been verified end-to-end, report Amber with a stated condition.

Risk rating: a risk that could stop go-live and has no named owner must be rated at least Medium.
